{{Quote|You're all Jedi? What are you doing here?''"<br />"''Captured on Suurja&mdash;ambushed.|[[Jarael]] and [[Ferroh]]|<ref name="KotOR8">[[Knights of the Old Republic 8|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 8]]</ref>}}
'''Suurja''' was an [[Agriworld/Legends|agrarian]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with a breathable [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] that was located within the [[Suurja system/Legends|Suurja system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and harbored both a native [[Species/Legends|species]] called [[Suurjan]]s and a [[Colonist/Legends|colonist]] population of 16 million. By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3966 BBY/Legends|3966 BBY]], Suurja served as a resource world for the nearby [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|city-covered]] planet of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]].

During the early phase of the [[Mandalorian Wars|conflict]] between the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], both sides [[First battle of Suurja|engaged]] [[Second battle of Suurja|in]] [[Third battle of Suurja|four]] [[Fourth battle of Suurja|devastating]] yet inconclusive battles on Suurja that made many of the world's inhabitants [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]]. In [[3964 BBY]], the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] [[Ambush on Suurja|captured]] a large group of [[Revanchist|Jedi crusaders]] on Suurja's surface and took them to the [[Flashpoint Stellar Research Station]] as experimental subjects for the Mandalorian [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Demagol]].

==Description==
Suurja was an [[Agriworld/Legends|agrarian]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Prime Edition" /> that was located within the [[Suurja system/Legends|Suurja system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The planet was the [[Star system/Legends|star system's]] primary world<ref name="CSWE" /> and was a part of the [[Ojoster sector/Legends|Ojoster sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
{{Quote|And now we learn that some of them were abducted from Suurja ''before'' the surprise attack&mdash;and after ''you'' left for Onderon!|[[Vrook Lamar]], to the [[Revan/Legends|Revanchist]], on the Jedi crusaders|<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic 9">[[Knights of the Old Republic 9|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 9]]</ref>}}
By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3966 BBY/Legends|3966 BBY]],<ref name="date3966">"[[The Taris Holofeed: Siege Edition]]," which is set concurrently with [[Knights of the Old Republic 15|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 15]] and thus in [[3963 BBY]], states that the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] began to threaten Suurja three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the events depicted in the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]]; thus the date [[3966 BBY/Legends|3966 BBY]] can be derived.</ref> Suurja served as a resource world for [[Taris/Legends|Taris]],<ref name="Siege Edition">{{KOTORbackups|15}}</ref> a nearby<ref name="TEA" /> [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|city-covered]] planet.<ref name="KotORCG">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> That year, the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]],<ref name="Siege Edition" /> who had been [[Mandalorian Wars|conquering]] independent planets beyond [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]&ndash;controlled [[Realspace/Legends|space]] for a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]],<ref name="TEA" /> began to threaten Suurja and other Tarisian resource worlds, causing the Republic to grant Taris membership and [[Republic Military/Legends|military]] protection.<ref name="Siege Edition" /> As a result, a Republic security cordon called the [[Jebble-Vanquo-Tarnith line]] was created, and Suurja was one of the worlds that was located on the frontline.<ref name="TEA" /> The [[3965 BBY|following year]], the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] forces [[First battle of Suurja|engaged]] the Republic Military<ref name="EGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> in [[Second battle of Suurja|four]] [[Third battle of Suurja|inconclusive]] [[Fourth battle of Suurja|battles]] on Suurja in the span of six [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]],<ref name="Prime Edition" /> devastating the planet and forcing many of the agrarian world's inhabitants to become [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]]. The Mandalorians followed the fugitives to such planets as [[Vanquo]].<ref name="CSWE" />

[[File:Captured_Jedi.jpg|thumb|right|300px|A group of Revanchists are captured by the Mandalorians on Suurja.]]
In [[3964 BBY]],<ref name="KotOR6" /> a large group of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] affiliated with the [[Revanchist]] faction of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]<ref name="Secret Journal">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/fiction/demagol/index.html?page=1|text="The Secret Journal of Doctor Demagol"|int=The Secret Journal of Doctor Demagol (article)|newhost=Suvudu}}</ref> were present on Suurja on a [[Scout/Legends|scouting]] mission. They were [[Ambush on Suurja|ambushed]] by Mandalorian forces,<ref name="KotOR8" /> who were also on the planet<ref name="KotOR6" /> despite the earlier departure of the Mandalorian forces from the Suurja system.<ref name="Prime Edition" /> Many [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who survived the surprise attack,<ref name="CSWE" /> including the [[Human/Legends|Human]] Jedi Knight [[Darth Malak|Alek]], were captured by the Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders and transported to the [[Flashpoint Stellar Research Station]], a facility where the Mandalorian [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Demagol]] was conducting experiments on Jedi.<ref name="KotOR8" />

That same year, the former Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Zayne Carrick]] posed as a refugee from Suurja in order to infiltrate an [[Unidentified mining outpost|outpost]] of [[Miner/Legends|miners]] on Vanquo.<ref name="KotOR7">[[Knights of the Old Republic 7|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 7]]</ref> [[3963 BBY]] saw Suurja being mentioned in a Republic [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]] broadcast by "[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Benegryph Goodvalor|Goodvalor]]"<ref name="Interference">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/fiction/interference20090929.html|text="Interference"|int=Interference|newhost=Suvudu}}</ref>&mdash;in reality, the [[Actor/Legends|actor]] [[Marn Hierogryph's brother|brother]] of the accidental Republic hero [[Marn Hierogryph]].<ref name="KOTOR47">[[Knights of the Old Republic 47|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 47]]</ref> "Goodvalor" characterized Suurja as a "rimworld" and described the activities of the Mandalorians on conquered worlds such as Suurja as "pillaging [[Clothing/Legends|dress]] shops and [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] stands."<ref name="Interference" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Quote|Suurjans don't have ears.|[[Marn Hierogryph]]|<ref name="KotOR25" />}}
Suurja was home to [[Suurjan]]s, a [[Species/Legends|species]] that lacked [[Ear/Legends|ears]].<ref name="KotOR25" /> The agrarian world also had a [[Colonist/Legends|colonist]] population of 16 million.<ref name="Prime Edition" /> Many inhabitants of Suurja where forced to become refugees following the battles between the Republic and the Mandalorians that took place on the planet.<ref name="CSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Suurja made its first [[in-universe]] appearance in ''[[The Taris Holofeed: Prime Edition]]''&mdash;an article that was written by [[John Jackson Miller]] and published within the ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic/Rebellion flip-book]]''<ref name="Prime Edition" /> on [[March 1]], [[2006]].<ref name="DH">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/13-539/Star-Wars-Knights-of-the-Old-Republic-Rebellion-Flip-Book|text=Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic/Rebellion Flip Book}}</ref> The Suurja system, and therefore the planet Suurja, was placed in grid square N-7 by the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="TEA" />
